urdu_direction.fixture_cause: main.tsx 49,53 selects ur and calls the real applyDocumentDirection on <html>; 76 mounts DiffHistoryPager directly in a whitespace-pre-wrap div without an LTR/bidi-isolated body boundary. Thus RTL paragraph direction reaches plain spans at diff-history.tsx 662-700. CSS preview file adds no compensating code-direction rule. This concretely explains trailing neutral code markers in this fixture, not a translation-byte error.
urdu_direction.production_trace: DiffBlock root 231-256 has the same font-mono/pre-wrap div without dir; its full branch mounts pager at 297-303. Immediate integrated chain independently read: canonical-transcript.tsx 2850 DiffBlock -> details fragment 2913 -> ToolLedgerRow details=3030 inside MessageContainer 2965; tool-row.tsx 1192-1207 Disclosure children; disclosure.tsx 624-633 body div; message-container.tsx 64-66 body div. None supplies an LTR body boundary. tool-row.tsx 1146 bdi isolates only the summary, not these details. Production shared/i18n/use-document-direction.ts 33-49 sets document direction via the same helper. Targeted CSS direction/Unicode-bidi search found no diff-specific override.
urdu_direction.attribution_limit: This supports a component-level inherited-direction weakness and a concrete integration risk, not a reproduced full-app regression; farther app ancestry/computed styles were not observed. Do not change Urdu translations, reorder numbers or add manual bidi controls to conceal it. If pursued, verify actual integrated code-body direction separately and isolate code/range at the rendering seam as appropriate.
